text: RGTI is down 26% and 57% off its high with shrinking revenue and deep losses — this thesis is broken and the position should be closed before further damage.
QBTS is 38% off its high with negative cash flow and repeated earnings misses — quantum computing speculation isn't paying off and it's time to cut this loss.
SKYT is up 64% and near its 52-week high but MACD just turned bearish — consider locking in some of that profit before momentum fades.
LASR is up 72.5% but trades at a PE of 111 on a tiny £246 position — take some profit off the table since a stock this expensive can reverse quickly.
IONQ is deeply unprofitable with no clear path to earnings, and quantum computing stocks are getting punished broadly — trim to reduce your exposure to this speculative theme.
Microsoft is 20% off its high which is rare for a company growing revenue 15% with strong free cash flow — this pullback in a best-in-class name is worth adding to.
Lockheed Martin at a PE of 16.2 with solid cash flow and steady growth is a good value in a defensive name — worth building this position while it's reasonably priced.
